Bhide confesses to the society members that he blindly signed an agreement pawning Madhavi’s jewelry at an exorbitant interest rate (10% daily). When the recovery agent, Gafoor Ghisela, arrives to collect the money, Bhide tears up the contract, and the Gokuldham society traps and confronts him.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
